description: Verify that TCP reassembles queued incoming segments and returns the data to a RECEIVE call in EST / FIN-WAIT-1 / FIN-WAIT-2 (RFC 793 §3.9 p58 Event Processing)
approach:
[Objective]
The receive path must coalesce segments into the application-visible byte stream. Three iterations send 4 × 32 B segments per phase and verify a single 128 B UT recv per phase.

[Scenario — chronological]
Three iterations, one per state:
1. Phase 1 (EST): tester sends 4 × 32 B segments → DUT recv reports 128 B.
2. Phase 2 (FW1): same after DUT-side CLOSE.
3. Phase 3 (FW2): same after tester ACKs DUT FIN.

[Pass condition]
Each phase reports correct 128 B reassembled data.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_p<n>_* — handshake / FIN / data per-phase missing or wrong

verdicts.Pass: DUT reassembled 4×32 B → 128 B in all 3 phases — normal
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 1 EST
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_proper_data: DUT did not receive proper data phase 1 EST
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 2 FW1
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_proper_data: DUT did not receive proper data phase 2 FW1
verdicts.Fail_p3_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 3 FW2
verdicts.Fail_p3_no_proper_data: DUT did not receive proper data phase 3 FW2
